prose:
A Techmeme-linked Q&A points to the same Dwarkesh conversation between Ege Erdil and Daniel Kokotajlo. Its opening contrasts their expectations for rapid software-driven AI progress while showing agreement that governance and the consequences of future power deserve attention.

These are subjective forecasts and policy arguments, not calibrated measurements or proof of an imminent intelligence explosion. The probability depends on the question and horizon; the host's stronger framing about death is explicitly qualified by Kokotajlo. The readable transcript was long and incomplete at the retrieval limit, so later predictions were not exhaustively checked. Sponsorship material is separate, and no policy, registration or research action was taken.
highlights: Discussion distinguishes timelines from preferred interventions
Participants attach different probabilities to software acceleration
Forecasts are subjective rather than measured event rates
Kokotajlo qualifies the host's opening characterization
No single outcome or timetable is established
Transcript retrieval did not include the entire episode
Sponsor offers and calls to action were not followed
